adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no `topic_id` is found it does `render 'loading'` but does not `return`, and then still executes `discourse_expires_in 1.minute`. That means the loading/placeholder response will be sent with caching headers, which can cause the browser/proxies to cache the loading page for up to a minute even after the topic becomes available. Additionally, `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb` unconditionally reloads the page every 30 seconds with no retry limit or failure handling, so if retrieval never succeeds the client will keep reloading indefinitely.
